column1: # The keigo, keigo-prefix and command-form rows of reader.tsv as the source spells the words: the
# stage looks for them in the text of the words the word stage read in a dialogue line (its items,
# stems and endings joined). Every such row of reader.tsv has a row here.
#   row    the reader.tsv row: keigo:<lemma>, keigo-prefix:<prefix>+<verb>, command-form:<form>
#   start  spellings that start the word, | between them; keigo-prefix rows: what follows お or 御 and a
#          verb stem (kanji, then one kana of the い or え row: お待ちになる, お伺いする, お持ちいたす)
#   not    text at the same place that is another word, | between them; _ marks where the spelling
#          starts when the text begins before it (み_なさ: the なさ of みなさん)
# A command-form row also counts every verb the word stage conjugated in the imperative (見ろ, 追え).
